description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RustAdapter plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external dependencies related to plugin initialization, deinitialization, reference counting, and communication with other components.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A class implementing the plugin interface for RustAdapter, managing plugin lifecycle, communication, and external interactions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the implementation based on profile type and configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC or callback invocation depending on compile-time conditions.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Constructs the library path or name based on inputs.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for a given service and callsign.
